name: Storm Burger
facts: Storm Burger has locations in Inglewood and Long Beach. Compton is coming soon.
Inglewood: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302. Sun-Thu 10:30 AM-12 AM, Fri-Sat 10:30 AM-1 AM.
Long Beach: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805. Mon-Wed 10:30 AM-10 PM, Thu-Sun 10:30 AM-11 PM.
Compton (coming soon): 336 W Alondra Blvd, Compton, CA 90220.
You earn 20 points for every $1 you spend.
Rewards: 1,000 pts Free fries, 1,800 pts Free shake, 3,000 pts Free Classic StormBurger, 4,500 pts Free combo.
Bonuses: 50 pts check-in, 100 pts first order, 200 pts birthday, 250 pts app feedback.
Referral: you get 150 pts when a friend joins, then 100 pts on their first order and 25 pts on each order after.
Storm Run is free to play with no account. It has 10 levels of 90 seconds, and you have 5 lives.
Storm Run prizes: 400 Free house sauce, 600 Free fries or onion rings, 800 Free milkshake, 1,000 Free Classic StormBurger.
The weekly top Storm Run score wins a Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo. The board resets every Monday.
The Daily Spin is free, once a day, with no purchase needed.
Game prizes and spin food prizes must be used within 3 days, and you can use one reward per visit.
Joining takes a name, phone number and email. It's one free account per person and per phone.
You must be 13 or older to play. If you're under 18, you need a parent's or guardian's permission.
Your info is only used for your rewards account and is never sold.
suggested: What rewards can I get and how many points do they cost?
How do I play Storm Run and win prizes?

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Inglewood is open Sun-Thu 10:30 AM-12 AM and Fri-Sat 10:30 AM-1 AM. Long Beach is open Mon-Wed 10:30 AM-10 PM and Thu-Sun 10:30 AM-11 PM.

qa.q: What time do you open?
qa.a: Both locations open at 10:30 AM every day.

qa.q: What time do you close?
qa.a: Inglewood closes at 12 AM Sun-Thu and 1 AM Fri-Sat. Long Beach closes at 10 PM Mon-Wed and 11 PM Thu-Sun.

qa.q: Are you open late night?
qa.a: Inglewood is open until 12 AM Sun-Thu and until 1 AM Fri-Sat. Long Beach is open until 11 PM Thu-Sun.

qa.q: Are you open on Sundays?
qa.a: Yes. Inglewood is open Sunday 10:30 AM-12 AM. Long Beach is open Sunday 10:30 AM-11 PM.

qa.q: Are you open on weekends?
qa.a: Yes. Inglewood is open Fri-Sat 10:30 AM-1 AM and Sunday until 12 AM. Long Beach is open Thu-Sun 10:30 AM-11 PM.

qa.q: Inglewood hours?
qa.a: Sun-Thu 10:30 AM-12 AM, Fri-Sat 10:30 AM-1 AM.

qa.q: Long Beach hours?
qa.a: Mon-Wed 10:30 AM-10 PM, Thu-Sun 10:30 AM-11 PM.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: Inglewood: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302. Long Beach: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805. Compton is coming soon.

qa.q: What's the Inglewood address?
qa.a: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302.

qa.q: What's the Long Beach address?
qa.a: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805.

qa.q: Is the Compton location open?
qa.a: Not yet. Compton is coming soon, at 336 W Alondra Blvd, Compton, CA 90220. I don't have an opening date.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the Directions button under the location you want, either Inglewood or Long Beach.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff at the location.

qa.q: Do you have a drive-thru?
qa.a: I don't have that detail. Please ask staff at the location.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: I don't have a phone number to show here. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: How do I contact the restaurant?
qa.a: I don't have a phone number for you, but staff can help at the counter. You can also find Storm Burger on Instagram at @stormburger.

qa.q: Do you have happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have any happy hour info. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have daily specials?
qa.a: I don't have daily specials listed. We do run holiday specials, so ask me about those, and staff can tell you what's on today.

qa.q: What holiday specials do you have?
qa.a: Thunder Night Combo (Oct 20-31), Gobble Burger (Nov 20-28), Holiday Shake Stack (Dec 15-25), New Year BBQ Combo (Dec 29-Jan 1), Burgers for Two (Feb 7-14), Lucky Strips Combo (Mar 14-17), Cinco Spicy Combo (May 1-5), and Fourth of July Classic (Jul 1-4).

qa.q: What is the Gobble Burger?
qa.a: It's a Turkey Burger with Onion Rings, the Thanksgiving-week special. It runs Nov 20-28.

qa.q: What is the Holiday Shake Stack?
qa.a: It's a Double Classic StormBurger with a Mix Shake (vanilla and chocolate). It runs Dec 15-25.

qa.q: What is the Thunder Night Combo?
qa.a: It's a Jalapeño Lightning Burger Combo with Thunder sauce on the side. It runs Oct 20-31.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: We have combos (Classic StormBurger, Jalapeño Lightning Burger, Kids, Chicken Sandwich), burgers (Jalapeño Lightning, Kids, Turkey), a Mix Shake, and homemade sauces. Scroll to The menu in the app to see everything.

qa.q: How much is a Classic StormBurger Combo?
qa.a: $11.99. It comes with fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: How much is the Jalapeño Lightning Burger?
qa.a: The burger alone is $6.99. The combo is $13.99.

qa.q: What's in the Jalapeño Lightning Burger?
qa.a: Homemade avocado crema, Storm sauce, a 4oz patty, Swiss cheese, grilled onions and jalapeños.

qa.q: What comes with the combos?
qa.a: All combos come with fries and a soft drink. You can upgrade fries to onion rings for +$2.00 and the drink to a milkshake for +$2.00.

qa.q: Do you have a kids menu?
qa.a: Yes. The Kids Burger (4oz patty, American cheese) is $5.99. The Kids Combo adds fries and a soft drink for $11.99.

qa.q: How much is the Chicken Sandwich Combo?
qa.a: $12.99, with fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: Do you have a turkey burger?
qa.a: Yes. The Turkey Burger is $6.99. It has two 2oz turkey patties, lettuce, tomato, cheese, onions, pickles and burger sauce.

qa.q: What shakes do you have?
qa.a: The app shows a Mix Shake for $4.99 ("Why not both?"). Our game prizes mention vanilla, chocolate or mix shakes.

qa.q: What sauces do you have?
qa.a: Homemade sauces at $1.00 each: Storm, BBQ, Honey Mustard and Spicy Mayo.

qa.q: What is Storm sauce?
qa.a: It's our homemade classic signature burger sauce, $1.00.

qa.q: Can I build my own burger?
qa.a: Yes. Use Build your own in the app with the Smash burger or Chicken sandwich tab. Tap or drag toppings on, watch the price update, then place your order.

qa.q: Can I add bacon or extra patties?
qa.a: Yes, in the build-your-own burger. Bacon and extra patties are add-ons, and the builder shows each price as you add them.

qa.q: Do you have a chicken sandwich?
qa.a: Yes. The Chicken Sandwich Combo is $12.99. You can also build a hand-breaded chicken sandwich in the app, with a Thunder spicy option.

qa.q: Do you have onion rings?
qa.a: Yes. You can upgrade combo fries to onion rings for +$2.00.

qa.q: How do I order?
qa.a: Tap Order Inglewood or Order Long Beach at the top of the app, or build a burger in the app and tap Place order. Staff can also help at the counter.

qa.q: Can I order from my table with a QR code?
qa.a: I don't have table-ordering details. Please ask staff.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: I don't have payment details. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: How do I join the rewards program?
qa.a: Join Storm Burger Rewards in the app with your name, phone number and email. It's free.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to join?
qa.a: No. It's a free member account, one per person and per phone.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play the game?
qa.a: No. Storm Run is free for anyone with no account. You only need a free account to save your score or claim a prize after a run.

qa.q: What do I get for signing up?
qa.a: The welcome offer in the app is free fries with your next burger. You'll also be able to earn points and save game prizes.

qa.q: How old do I have to be to play?
qa.a: You must be 13 or older. If you're under 18, you need a parent's or guardian's permission.

qa.q: How do points work?
qa.a: You earn 20 points for every $1 you spend. You also get bonus points for check-ins, your first order, your birthday, feedback and referrals. Then trade points for rewards.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: 20 points for every $1 you spend.

qa.q: How do I earn points on my order?
qa.a: Show your member QR or code to the cashier when you pay. You can also enter the code from your receipt.

qa.q: Do I get points for visiting?
qa.a: Yes. When you show your QR on a new day, you get a 50-point check-in bonus.

qa.q: Is there a first order bonus?
qa.a: Yes, 100 bonus points on your first order.

qa.q: Do I get points for giving feedback?
qa.a: Yes. You can earn 250 points for feedback in the app. Google reviews never earn points.

qa.q: Do I earn points for a Google review?
qa.a: No. Google doesn't allow rewards for reviews, so we never give points for them. Honest reviews are always welcome.

qa.q: How many points are the rewards?
qa.a: 1,000 pts = Free fries. 1,800 pts = Free shake. 3,000 pts = Free Classic StormBurger. 4,500 pts = Free combo.

qa.q: How many points for free fries?
qa.a: 1,000 points. At 20 points per $1, that's $50 spent.

qa.q: How many points for a free shake?
qa.a: 1,800 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free Classic StormBurger?
qa.a: 3,000 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free combo?
qa.a: 4,500 points.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Open your rewards in the app and pick the reward you have enough points for. Then show the code on your phone at the counter.

qa.q: Do points expire?
qa.a: I don't have any expiration info for points. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Do points have cash value?
qa.a: No. Points have no cash value.

qa.q: Do you have levels or tiers?
qa.a: The reward ladder has four steps: Free fries, Free shake, Free Classic StormBurger and Free combo. I don't have details on member levels.

qa.q: Do you have a birthday club?
qa.a: Yes. Add your birthday to your account and you'll get 200 bonus points for your birthday.

qa.q: Can I refer a friend?
qa.a: Yes. You get 150 points when a friend joins with your code, 100 points on their first order, and 25 points on each order after. Your friend gets free fries.

qa.q: Is there a double points offer?
qa.a: If you're near a Storm Burger and allow location, the app may show an alert: show it at the counter for double stars on today's order.

qa.q: What is Storm Run?
qa.a: It's our free driving game. You drive a food truck through the storm from Inglewood to Long Beach, grabbing coins and StormBurger food and dodging hazards. You can win prizes from your score.

qa.q: How do I play Storm Run?
qa.a: Swipe left or right to change lanes, or tap the left or right side to move one lane. On a computer, use the arrow keys. Grab coins and food, and dodge lightning, cows, stop signs, police and tornadoes.

qa.q: What are the Storm Run controls?
qa.a: Swipe left/right on the road, or tap a side of the road to move one lane. On a computer, use the ◀ ▶ arrow keys. Game controllers work too.

qa.q: How long is a Storm Run?
qa.a: There are 10 levels of 90 seconds each. You have 5 lives. The first 10 seconds are calm so you can get a feel for the controls.

qa.q: How do lives work in Storm Run?
qa.a: You have 5 lives, and every hit takes half a life. After 10 hits the truck is totaled.

qa.q: How do I score points in Storm Run?
qa.a: Coins are +10. Food is worth +30 to +60. You also get a level bonus of 100 times the level number. Hits take points off.

qa.q: How much is each food worth in Storm Run?
qa.a: Classic StormBurger +60, Turkey Burger +60, Chicken Sandwich +50, Chicken Strips +50, Vanilla Shake +40, Lemonade +40, Fries +30, Onion Rings +30.

qa.q: What should I dodge in Storm Run?
qa.a: Lightning (move off the glowing target), flying cows, stop signs, police cars, roadblocks, spike strips and tornadoes. Lightning, cows and stop signs each cost −100 and half a life. A roadblock costs −150, and a twister takes a big chunk of your score.

qa.q: What is the pit stop?
qa.a: On some levels you can pull into the Jordan High pit stop and build burgers for the Panthers. Each burger gives +75 points, and the kids repair your truck for +1 life. It happens on levels 2, 6 and 9.

qa.q: What are the Antidote Drizzle coins?
qa.a: Catch 5 gold Antidote Drizzle coins (+25 each) to unlock Antidote's StormBurger review on a roadside billboard. Drive through its golden ▶ for +500 bonus points.

qa.q: How often can I play Storm Run?
qa.a: As often as you like. It's free with no limit.

qa.q: What prizes can I win in Storm Run?
qa.a: One run over 400 wins a Free house sauce. Over 600, Free fries or onion rings. Over 800, a Free milkshake. Over 1,000, a Free Classic StormBurger. The weekly top score wins a Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo.

qa.q: How do I claim a game prize?
qa.a: Save it to your Storm Burger Rewards with a free account. You'll get a code to show at the counter.

qa.q: How long do I have to use a game prize?
qa.a: 3 days. You can hold one prize at a time, so use it before your next win saves.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest Storm Run score from Monday through Sunday close wins. Ties go to the score posted first. The board resets every Monday.

qa.q: What does the weekly champion win?
qa.a: A Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo for the top score by Sunday close.

qa.q: When does the weekly board close?
qa.a: Sunday close. The champions card in the app counts down to Sunday 11:00 PM.

qa.q: When are weekly prizes picked up?
qa.a: I don't have a pickup day. After you win, show your code and matching account at the counter, and use the prize within 3 days.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use bots?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: Can employees win prizes?
qa.a: Employees and their household members can play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: Do I have to buy something to play or win?
qa.a: No. No purchase is necessary to play Storm Run, spin the wheel or win, and buying doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: What is the Daily Spin?
qa.a: It's a free spin of the wheel, once per day. Every slice wins something.

qa.q: How often can I spin?
qa.a: Once per member per day, by Los Angeles time. Spins are never sold.

qa.q: What can I win on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +100 points (30%), +200 points (20%), +150 points (15%), free house sauce (15%), $2 off any burger (8%), free fries (7%) or 10% off your order (5%).

qa.q: How do I use a spin prize?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at either location. You can use one reward per visit, and rewards can't be combined or transferred.

qa.q: Can I combine rewards?
qa.a: No. You can use one reward per visit, and rewards can't be combined with other rewards.

qa.q: Does any prize include alcohol?
qa.a: No. No prize includes alcohol.

qa.q: Does the game have music and sound?
qa.a: Yes. Use the Sound on/off button. There are two songs, Energy and Cheat Code, which you can switch between.

qa.q: Can I switch the game to 2D?
qa.a: Yes. In Settings, View lets you pick the 3D chase cam or Classic 2D. You can also change Graphics for smoother play.

qa.q: Can I play with a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. Pair a controller and press any button. Use left/right on the stick or D-pad to change lanes.

qa.q: What is halftime?
qa.a: After about 90 seconds of total play, a short break may play Antidote The Foodie's review clips of Storm Burger. You can skip it or watch the full review.

qa.q: Do you have trivia or sports features?
qa.a: I don't have any trivia or sports features listed for Storm Burger.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Use the 🌐 language button to pick English, Español, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 한국어, Tagalog, Tiếng Việt, Հայերեն, فارسی, 日本語, ไทย or Русский. Brand and game names stay in English.

qa.q: Is there a kid mode?
qa.a: I don't have a kid mode for this app. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: Choose Add to Home Screen. On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, then Add. On Android, tap Install or use the ⋮ menu, then Add to Home screen.

qa.q: Can I save my rewards card to my phone's wallet?
qa.a: I don't have a wallet card. You can add the app to your Home Screen so your rewards are one tap away.

qa.q: Do you have Instagram?
qa.a: Yes, @stormburger. The app shows their latest posts and reels near the bottom.

qa.q: How do I leave a Google review?
qa.a: Use the Write a Google review button in the app. It takes about 30 seconds. Honest reviews only.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Ask at the counter. I don't have a phone number to show, so staff in the restaurant are the best way to reach someone.

qa.q: Is my information private?
qa.a: Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.

qa.q: How do I stop texts or emails?
qa.a: Reply STOP to any text or unsubscribe from emails, anytime. Deal texts are optional.

qa.q: What happens to my location?
qa.a: If you turn on location to see how close you are, it stays on your phone.

qa.q: Can I have more than one account?
qa.a: No. It's one free member account per person and per phone.

qa.q: Do you have gluten-free or vegan options?
qa.a: I don't have allergy or diet info. Please ask staff before you order.
